name: parakeet-unified-en-0.6b v5 (Rezolve domain fine-tune)
short_description: parakeet-unified-en-0.6b fine-tuned on Rezolve domain audio (TTS + real prod clips); encoder frozen; WER 4.62%, EA-DV 100% on 19-clip gold-92 test split.
architecture: FastConformer-Hybrid Transducer-CTC (English-only, 0.6B params). Encoder frozen during fine-tune; only the RNNT decoder and CTC head were updated.
